label: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017
output:
@Kavya, I’m writing this here because I don’t want a public back-and-forth with you. You’re a friend, and you’ve helped me more than most people in our batch know. But I also can’t stay quiet when a version of this is going around that isn’t fully true. So let me own what’s mine and correct the rest, once.

For context: Kavya and I are both Foundry91 cohort 4. Her app is SitterNest; mine is DabbaDost. Demo day was March 2026. Same batch, same city, same small hiring pool. I’m not writing this to litigate a post. I’m writing because 60+ comments and tags are now repeating a number and a story that people will take as fact. If I stay quiet, 40% becomes the truth. It isn’t.

Mine: I knew from day one where the two engineers worked. I should have called Kavya before we made the offers, not after. That was my miss, and I’m sorry. In a cohort of 11 startups hiring from the same HSR/Koramangala pool, this will keep happening. The decent rule is simple: if you’re interviewing someone from another batch company, give that founder a heads-up before you make the offer. I’d support that for our cohort, and I’ll follow it.

The rest: We put a backend developer role on our LinkedIn page and Instahyre on 14 Sept. It was open to anyone. One engineer applied himself on 19 Sept. The second came two weeks later as his referral. Nobody from my side DMed anyone in her team. The offer was 22% over current CTC, not 40%. Both joined on 3 Nov. On ESOPs, we do have a pool. It’s small, but it’s real and on paper since January. I’m not naming either person here; they didn’t ask to be part of this.

Kavya, I still remember you sitting with me till 1am in the Koramangala office fixing our Razorpay webhook mess before demo day. I haven’t forgotten that, and I’m not trying to score points now. I did message you after the second offer was accepted. I wish we’d spoken properly before either of us put something public out. That’s on me too, for not picking up the phone earlier.

I’m not looking for a fight. I respect you, and I want you to see that. If you’re open to it, coffee or a call this week, whenever you’re okay. No agenda, just talk.

*Swap @Kavya for her actual LinkedIn tag.*
